name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ShallowSplit.fixed_rows_linearIndependent
title: A walk with prefix-local flips forces the never-changed prefix rows to be linearly independent
statement: Over a field K, rows X : V -> (iota -> K) and linear residual maps L t : (iota -> K) -> (U -> K). If every x has t, u with L (t+1) (X x) u != L t (X x) u and L (t+1) (X y) u = L t (X y) u for all y != x, then X is linearly independent.
